items.definition:
statistically independent; at right angles
The two concepts are orthogonal, meaning they are independent of each other.

relating to a senator or the Senate
He launched his senatorial campaign last month.

having or showing a strong or unreasoning desire for revenge
He had a vindictive streak and never forgave an insult.

inspiring disgust and loathing; repugnant
Racism is abhorrent to me.

characterized by friendliness and absence of discord
They reached an amicable agreement after the dispute.

relating to, involving, or requiring an absence of free oxygen
Anaerobic exercise builds muscle strength.

Having or showing prejudice against Jewish people.
The politician was accused of making antisemitic remarks.

Relating to physical, especially sexual, needs and activities.
The novel explored themes of both spiritual and carnal love.

able to burn or corrode organic tissue by chemical action; sarcastic in a scathing and bitter way.
The chemical was so caustic that it dissolved the metal.

moving or tending to move away from a center.
The centrifugal force pushed the riders against the wall of the spinning ride.

relating to or denoting a 24-hour cycle in the physiological processes of living beings.
Our bodies have a natural circadian rhythm that regulates sleep and wakefulness.

driven to behave irrationally due to anger, distress, or excitement; suffering from dementia.
The old man's demented ramblings worried his family.

impressive and imposing in appearance or style, especially pretentiously so
He had grandiose plans for a world tour.

occurring, awarded, or appearing after the death of the originator
He received a posthumous award for his bravery.

deserving censure or condemnation
His actions were utterly reprehensible.

severely critical; devastating
The critic delivered a scathing review of the new play.

exercising power in a cruel or arbitrary way
The people rebelled against their tyrannical ruler.

suitable for growing crops
The region has a large amount of arable land.

using artificial body parts or electronic devices to assist or replace natural ones
The athlete was fitted with a bionic leg after the accident.

lacking sensitivity, refinement, or intelligence
His crass remarks offended many people in the audience.

devilish; evil
He came up with a diabolical plan to get revenge.

of little significance, able to be sacrificed
In war, some soldiers are considered expendable.

imaginary and unrealistic; bizarre
The story featured fantastical creatures and magical lands.

having a strong effect on someone or something
Her speech was incredibly impactful.

unable to be avoided or denied
The truth was inescapable.

Containing nitrogen, especially in a low oxidation state.
Nitrous oxide is commonly known as laughing gas.

Capable of causing disease.
Scientists are studying the pathogenic bacteria to develop new treatments.

sacrilegious; vulgar
His language was often profane, offending many.

generally considered or reputed to be
The putative father denied paternity.

not being what it purports to be; false or fake
He made a spurious claim about his qualifications.

relating to tension; capable of being stretched
The material has high tensile strength, making it very durable.

showing a selfless concern for the well-being of others
Her altruistic actions helped many people in need.

without a clearly defined shape or form
The cloud of gas was amorphous, constantly changing its shape.

showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks
It was an audacious plan, but it succeeded.

self-assertive in a rude, noisy, or overbearing way
His brash attitude often offended people.

in an acutely disturbed state of mind resulting from illness or intoxication
The patient was delirious with fever.

not candid or sincere
It was disingenuous of him to claim he knew nothing about the incident.

having or showing initiative and resourcefulness
She is an enterprising young woman with many business ideas.

demanding, strict
The conductor was exacting in his demands for precision from the orchestra.

relating to old people, especially with regard to their healthcare
The hospital has a specialized geriatric ward for elderly patients.

uncompromising or extreme in one's views or policies
The government adopted a hardline stance against the protesters.

too bad to be excused or justified
His rude behavior was inexcusable.

tending to inhibit or restrain
The drug had an inhibitory effect on the growth of bacteria.

combining or coordinating separate elements so as to provide a harmonious or interrelated whole
The new policy aims to be more integrative, bringing different departments together.

relating to nitrogen or nitrates
Nitric acid is a highly corrosive substance.

confined or shut in
He released his pent-up frustration with a shout.

too expensive to buy or do; preventing something
The cost of the new software was prohibitive for small businesses.

relating to the testes
Testicular cancer is a serious but often treatable condition.

beyond or above the range of normal or merely physical human experience
He spoke of a transcendent spiritual experience.

Seemingly without end; continuous.
The journey felt unending, stretching for miles.

Not willing to forgive or excuse; harsh or severe.
The desert can be an unforgiving environment for travelers.

Not demonstrated or shown to be true or valid.
His theories remain unproven without further evidence.

deviating from what is standard, normal, or expected
The results were anomalous and required further investigation.

split, divided, or partially divided into two
He had a distinctive cleft chin.

relating to static electricity
Dust often clings to surfaces due to electrostatic forces.

relating to a normal distribution
The data showed a Gaussian distribution.

uncalled for; lacking good reason; unwarranted
The film contained gratuitous violence.

peculiar or individual
His writing style is highly idiosyncratic.

Of or connected with the eyes or sight.
The doctor performed an ocular examination.

relating to the branch of medicine dealing with bones and muscles
He had to see an orthopedic surgeon for his knee injury.

understood or implied without being stated
There was a tacit agreement between them.

not impressive or exciting
The movie's ending was rather underwhelming.

not yet used or exploited
The region has vast untapped natural resources.

having a thick, sticky consistency between solid and liquid
Honey is a viscous substance.
